subject: ACK binding-keyed render retention; exact neutral provenance is available
body: Read-only retention ACK: generic-only compositorTextures/native-binding and compositorSamplers/native-binding works with current cleanup; draw_reorder.inc25 and compositor_submit.inc208/243 iterate all retained objects rather than interpreting Metal slots. Preserve fixed/compositor indexed consumers and slot30 MRT-retention convention. Current max nativebinding15 leaves slot30 distinct. For requested cheap used-slot source: pinned pipeline/layout.rs42-122 DescriptorBinding.source is exact BindingSource::Texture,CombinedTextureSampler{texture,...},SeparateTexture{texture,...},RawTexture; each has SlotRef and DescriptorBinding.stages. generic_plan already has layout_binding(w.binding) closure. Compute owner can populate existing GenericBinding.stage/index for neutral image from this static source (instead of hardcoded stage2,index0 at air_bridge.rs1740), or expose additive slot-used helper. Then render can reject ONLY unsupported texture at that exact(stage,index), not any unsupported binding anywhere plus an unrelated legal neutral. No extra struct size is needed. Add regression: unused unsupported VS tex5 + legitimately unbound active FS tex0 must retain the legal neutral draw; unsupported active VS tex5 must refuse.
